definitions.explanation: the raised edge of stone or concrete at the side of a road, separating the sidewalk from the street

examples.japanese: {縁石|えんせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}り{上|あ}げてしまった。
examples.english: I accidentally drove up onto the curb.

examples.japanese: {縁石|えんせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{躓|つまず}いて⟦{転|ころ}んだ→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧。
examples.english: I tripped on the curb and fell.

examples.japanese: {縁石|えんせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}って→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I sat on the curb and took a break.

notes:
{縁石|えんせき} refers to the raised stone or concrete border along the edge of a road or sidewalk — what English calls a "curb" or "kerb."

FORMS:
⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧ (edge, border) + {石|せき} (stone)

ALTERNATE READING:
Also read as へりいし, though えんせき is standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縁石|えんせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}り{上|あ}げる: to ride up onto the curb (a common driving mistake)
- {縁石|えんせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{躓|つまず}く: to trip on the curb
- {縁石|えんせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{腰掛|こしか}ける→腰掛ける：13945_koshikakeru⟧: to sit on the curb

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧: sidewalk
- ⟦{車道|しゃどう}→車道：03066_shadou⟧: roadway
- ⟦{路肩|ろかた}→路肩：20701_rokata⟧: road shoulder
